title: Extraterrestrial being interviewed behind a two-way mirror at S4

tellings.quote: so they went to Area 51 they got taken to S4 uh went down a number of flights down at S4 and they came to this area where there was this a a big room with a two-way mirror in it and there was an extraterrestrial being there

plain: Sometime in the 1950s or 60s, a group was said to be taken to S4, a secret site linked to Area 51, the restricted Air Force base in Nevada. They went down several floors to a big room with a two-way mirror, and on the other side was a being from another world, which they interviewed. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this, passing on what a man named Albert Stein told him, and he mentions card files kept from those S4 interviews.
